_comment: Keyword rules for bucketing an expense-line label into one of the ledger's named payment columns. Checked top-to-bottom, first match wins (case-insensitive regex, matched anywhere in the label). Anything that matches nothing stays in the residual 'Petty / other cash expense' bucket, which the sheet derives automatically as P-Exp = T-Exp minus the sum of the named columns — it is never entered by hand. Edit this file (or use the Rules tab in the app) to teach the system new vendor/driver names as you see them; changes apply to every day you re-run through the app.
